DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Acalculous Cholecystitis.

The ultrasound confirms an enlarged, thin-walled gallbladder without stones, which is the hallmark of this condition, often triggered by systemic stress from your severe illness. Given your jaundice and weight loss, this may be secondary to biliary obstruction from a pancreatic head mass or severe cholestasis; please proceed immediately to an MRI of the abdomen to evaluate the bile ducts and pancreas.
